coverIntro: Kramer Bouwservice runs several projects simultaneously. Lisa currently sees each project's margin only after manually combining timesheets and invoices, often too late to intervene. How can Kramer steer margins while work is underway? Datavance connects the unchanged Excel workflow and Exact Online in one current margin dashboard. The dashboard combines booked hours, revenue and purchases without asking foremen to change how they record their time. It gives Lisa and Erik a shared basis for Monday's review and flags margins below the agreed 15% threshold.
situation: Foremen keep emailing their familiar weekly Excel timesheets; Lisa combines these with Exact Online purchases. The weekly merge costs Lisa three to four hours. An ERP timesheet module would disrupt the foremen's existing work on site.
goals: See current project margins every Monday
approach: Nothing changes for the foremen. We standardise their files automatically and combine hours with revenue and purchases from Exact Online in Power BI. The calculation uses revenue minus booked hours and purchases per project. We align project codes and normalise differences between the foremen's spreadsheets before combining the data. A weekly refresh prepares the overview before Lisa's Monday meeting with Erik, while the fixed threshold makes exceptions immediately visible.
scopeDeliverables: Exact Online connection for project finances. Includes purchase invoices and account data matched to project codes.
Automated processing of weekly timesheets. Normalises columns and project references while retaining the emailed Excel format.
Margin dashboard with 15% alerts. Shows current margins per project, weekly refresh and exception flags for Monday's meeting.

phases.name: Week 1
phases.description: Connect sources and align project codes. Agree the timesheet format and check how purchases and hours map to projects.

phases.name: Weeks 2–4
phases.description: Build, test and deliver the dashboard. Run a cycle with real project data and adjust the result with Lisa before handover.

investment: One fixed price for this scoped problem, confirmed after the scoping call. The call confirms the connection setup, timesheet format and agreed threshold before work starts.
nextSteps: Approve the proposal, then schedule a 30-minute scoping call with Lisa and Erik. Use the call to inspect source data, agree the inputs and confirm when week one can begin.
